note: Articles and videos, each kept as a separate list for brothers and sisters. The switch in each section head swaps between them. The first article in a list is the large featured one; the rest follow beneath it in a carousel, so put the newest first. 'href' links the card (leave empty for no link). A video's 'thumbnail' is an image path; leave it empty for the patterned placeholder. Set 'moreHref' (and optionally 'moreLabel') on articles or videos to show an 'All …' link in the section head. An empty list shows a 'nothing yet' card.
